g.title: FailureRoutingAndTerminalOutcomes
g.text: TARGET OPERATING ARCHITECTURE · V1.2 · VIEW R4
M0 MANUAL CONTROL · Deterministic return · Independent incident closure

g.title: cluster_diagnostic
g.text: 01 DIAGNOSTIC · UNKNOWN CAUSE PRODUCES EVIDENCE, NEVER CORRECTION OR SUCCESS

g.title: cluster_corrective
g.text: 02 CORRECTIVE · ROUTE TO THE EARLIEST WRONG OWNER, INVALIDATE, MAP, AND RE-ENTER

g.title: cluster_authority_incident
g.text: 03 AUTHORITY & INCIDENT · RECONCILE ACTIONS; CONTAIN AND CLOSE SAFETY INDEPENDENTLY

g.title: cluster_real_completion
g.text: 04 REAL COMPLETION · PRODUCTION EVIDENCE ≠ PRODUCT SUCCESS; HUMAN DISPOSITION IS FINAL

g.title: r02
g.text: Product Unit or AC is wrong

g.title: obligation_mapping
g.text: MAP EVERY OLD OBLIGATION TO THE NEW REVISION
same Phase may preserve / strengthen only
weakened denominator → honest non-success + NEW PHASE

g.title: affected_gates
g.text: identity · review · verify · deploy · QA · release

g.title: fresh_corrective_evidence
g.text: FRESH PROOF FOR THE CHANGED IDENTITY

g.title: human_reconcile
g.text: new side effect requires fresh action identity

g.title: r08_ready
g.text: product / code conclusions retained unless contradicted

g.title: r09
g.text: verification / BA failed · partial · unknown · stale

g.title: r09_block
g.text: until safe state + resolved Incident + settled mutation
+ one non-diagnostic route + fresh Human authority

g.title: ir00
g.text: OPEN / PRESERVE THE EXACT INCIDENT CASE

g.title: ir02
g.text: rerun every affected identity · review · test

g.title: ir03
g.text: current safe environment · no unresolved mutation
Human resolves exact Case · NO PRODUCT-SUCCESS AUTHORITY

g.title: production_evidence
g.text: empty incident set · no unresolved action

g.title: business_acceptance
g.text: accept / reject the actual business result

g.title: f16
g.text: NO F17 / resume / competing Phase authority

g.title: f17
g.text: paused / awaiting rework · value + Baseline unchanged
incident resolved · environment safe · one non-diagnostic route
NO F16 / new-Phase / competing Phase authority

g.title: incident_closure_block
g.text: open Cases continue independently through IR00–IR03
